verdict.rationale: Token2 is a FIDO2/PIV security-key hardware vendor whose software is device-management tooling: a companion app, the fido2-manage CLI/GUI, and an Entra ID bulk-enrollment script. Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows belongs to automation platforms, not this product category. The evidence shows only one-shot scripts and an insert-triggered watcher, not any scheduler, so the axis does not apply.
